name: forward-app-theme-unknown-member
description: FORWARD tolerance (ggui#1093 belt, VERSION-POLICY §3.6): an AppTheme exactly as ggui Release 3 writes it PLUS a top-level member this release does not name (`futureMember`, synthetic — `fonts` and `imagery` became NAMED members with the #1093 carrier, so the forward case must always carry a key no release names). A READ door on this release MUST keep the theme — overlays byte-identical — strip the member and name it; dropping the whole theme over the unknown member is the violation (guuey#1266's class). Synthetic by construction: the payload is the NEXT release's, so it carries no landed sha.

release.label: a later ggui release (synthetic): Release 3's theme plus a synthetic `futureMember`
